outcome: Transverse Diameter of the Pelvic Inlet (TD)
cohort: 1,263 non-pregnant Japanese women aged 20-40 years, who underwent pelvic CT examination between 2016 and 2021, were included in the study.
finding: The mean obstetric conjugate (OC) was 127.0 mm and the mean transverse diameter of the pelvic inlet (TD) was 126.8 mm in modern Japanese women, which were larger than values reported in a 1972 survey.
